14.constraint: Use the warm-apricot ribbed henley knit once only for Fall or Winter Casual Everyday, Weekend, Travel, Campus, creative Work, or a relaxed daytime Date Night. Pair with one controlled straight bottom in charcoal, chocolate, stone, ecru or muted olive and a low-profile cream, tan or brown shoe; no oversized or puddled bottom, second ribbed layer, loud print or bulky sneaker.
